properties.description: crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_follow_up_is_owed_until_it_is_settled.rs, five cases over an in-memory design with one deployed service: a TemporalFact with fact_type follow_up and no valid_to is counted, listed with its subject and capture date, named in loop_status.next, and makes clean false; an INVALIDATES edge from a ChangeEvent clears it; a valid_to clears it; a finding of any other fact_type is not counted; two open ones come back oldest first. The door itself (the skill) is checked by check_command_surface.py and skill_lint.py in CI: the three skill copies are byte-identical, the command copy matches its source, and every tool and field the skill names exists on the served surface.
properties.findings: 5 passed, 0 failed; the existing report suite (20) still green alongside it. skill_lint and check_command_surface green after registering five field terms the new skill names.
properties.name: An open follow-up is listed by the loop until a record answers it or it lapses
